bio: W.S. Gong is a writer, editor, and software developer based in San Francisco, CA. His fiction appears in The Rumpus and Fourteen Hills. He is an alumnus of Bread Loaf, Sewanee, Tin House, and Kenyon Review, and a resident fellow of the Virginia Center for the Creative Arts.
A developer and technical writer, he builds and documents open-source tools on the Anthropic stack: MCP servers and Claude Code plugins.
